jobs.title: Senior Lead Digital Product Manager- Agentic Operations
jobs.description:
About this Role:

The Senior Lead Digital Product Manager for Agentic Operations will serve as the strategic product owner for enterprise AI agent operating capabilities that support Marketing business operations. This role is accountable for defining the product vision, strategy, roadmap, controls, performance measures, and adoption approach for agentic operations capabilities that enable reliable, measurable, compliant, and scalable business outcomes.

This individual contributor role requires advanced product management expertise, senior stakeholder influence, strong risk and control judgment, and the ability to translate emerging AI and agentic operating concepts into practical enterprise capabilities. The role will partner across product, technology, design, analytics, risk, compliance, legal, operations, and business leadership to shape the operating model for AI agents and ensure agentic solutions are governed, observable, resilient, and aligned to business priorities.

In this role, you will:
- Define and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for Agentic Operations capabilities supporting Marketing business operations.
- Serve as the business authority for agentic operations product capabilities, ensuring product decisions reflect customer, business, operational, risk, compliance, and technology needs.
- Establish product goals, objectives, key results, performance indicators, adoption measures, and value realization routines for agent health, reliability, usage, cost, latency, resilience, quality, and business impact.
- Lead product discovery and continuous research with stakeholders, users, technology partners, risk partners, and business teams to identify needs, validate problems, prioritize opportunities, and shape scalable solutions.
- Translate agentic operations needs into product epics, feature priorities, acceptance criteria, operating requirements, and sequencing recommendations aligned to enterprise product practices.
- Manage prioritization across agentic operations capabilities, balancing business value, customer and user impact, risk, compliance, technology complexity, cost, capacity, and strategic alignment.
- Partner with technology, architecture, data, security, model governance, and platform teams to design capabilities for agent observability, orchestration, escalation, resiliency, model suitability, knowledge access, and performance monitoring.
- Define and maintain operational guardrails for agent and LLM usage, including thresholds for autonomy, time, cost, risk, escalation, unsupported tool use, retries, exception handling, and business-approved use.
- Oversee product requirements for controls that prevent unmanaged agent behavior, including runaway loops, excessive retries, unsupported tool use, policy exceptions, inappropriate outputs, and activity outside approved risk tolerance.
- Shape product capabilities that support resilience, including fallback paths, failover routines, continuity expectations, human-in-the-loop escalation, exception handling, and business continuity when agents, models, tools, or knowledge sources are unavailable or degraded.
- Lead decisions on model suitability and routing strategy by balancing task complexity, quality expectations, latency, cost, risk, reasoning requirements, and approved model usage.
- Maintain visibility into token usage, model consumption, cost trends, capacity demand, agent utilization, and workflow performance at the agent, workflow, business area, and portfolio level.
- Translate token, cost, latency, quality, risk, usage, adoption, and performance data into product recommendations, roadmap trade-offs, capacity decisions, and executive-ready reporting.
- Serve as a senior product partner to technology and delivery teams, enabling sequencing, dependency management, delivery readiness, launch readiness, change adoption, and ongoing product performance improvement.
- Represent Agentic Operations in governance forums, portfolio planning, risk reviews, operating routines, and senior leadership discussions.
- Influence cross-functional partners without direct authority, aligning stakeholders around product priorities, risk decisions, delivery sequencing, roadmap trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead through ambiguity by establishing product structure, decision frameworks, operating standards, and practical solutions for emerging agentic AI capabilities in a regulated financial services environment.

Required Qualifications:
- 7+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
- Advanced experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, outcomes, requirements, epics, features, and delivery priorities for complex digital, data, platform, workflow, or technology-enabled capabilities.
- Experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives with company, line-of-business, or enterprise-level impact.
- Experience operating in a regulated environment with accountability for risk, compliance, controls, governance, audit readiness, privacy, information classification, or responsible technology practices.
- Experience using data, product performance metrics, customer or user insights, operational reporting, and business analysis to make product decisions and communicate recommendations.
- Experience partnering with technology, design, analytics, risk, compliance, legal, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes.

Desired Qualifications:
- Experience with enterprise AI platforms, LLM-based capabilities, AI agents, agent orchestration, observability tools, prompt operations, knowledge management, model routing, workflow automation, or AI-enabled product capabilities.
- Experience managing or supporting marketing capabilities such as marketing automation, audience operations, campaign orchestration, personalization, customer engagement, content operations, decisioning, or marketing workflow platforms.
- Experience developing product capabilities for monitoring, resiliency, explainability, auditability, escalation, human-in-the-loop operations, control management, or operational governance.
- Experience applying responsible AI, model risk, privacy, information security, audit, records, compliance, legal, or control expectations to digital, data, marketing, or technology-enabled business processes.
- Experience with agile delivery practices, backlog prioritization, product discovery, quarterly or PI planning, Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, product roadmaps, product scorecards, and cross-functional delivery routines.
- Experience developing operating models, playbooks, adoption plans, performance scorecards, capacity management routines, executive reporting, and value realization frameworks for digital or platform products.
- Experience leading senior stakeholder discussions, governance reviews, steering routines, portfolio planning, and strategic prioritization conversations.
- Experience managing product priorities, dependencies, sequencing, stakeholder alignment, and trade-off decisions across multiple teams or business areas.
- Financial services, consumer banking, lending, marketing, data, digital platform, or regulated technology experience.
- Strong understanding of human-centered design, customer experience, user research, product analytics, and technology delivery practices.
- Strong communication and executive-level storytelling skills, including the ability to translate technical, operational, AI, risk, and product concepts into clear recommendations for senior leaders.
- Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, lead through ambiguity, simplify complex problems, and align stakeholders around strategic priorities.
- Demonstrated ability to operate with a strong risk mindset while driving innovation, operational excellence, adoption, and measurable business value.

VISA Sponsorship will not be supported by this role.
Relocation will not be supported by this role.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Senior Lead Securities Product Manager
jobs.description:
Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB ) delivers a comprehensive suite of banking, capital markets, and advisory solutions, including a full complement of sales, trading, and research capabilities, to corporate, government, and institutional clients. We focus on our clients' overall financial needs while building long-term relationships founded on trust, transparency, and innovation.

The Chief Operating Office (COO) supports the business by delivering platforms, processes and systems across a wide range of disciplines. This includes LOB business management, business solutions & enablement, client lifecycle management, data management, strategy & transformation, and innovation.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking an experienced Senior Lead Securities Product Manager to join the Equities Cash & Derivatives (ECD) organization at the Executive Director level. The role owns strategic execution of the ECD Quantitative Investment Strategies (QIS) product roadmap and manages the Risk & Models product area within ECD, partnering across trading, sales, structuring, quantitative research, technology, risk, operations, finance, and compliance to modernize and scale the firm's systematic investing capabilities.
Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at  wellsfargojobs.com .

In this role you will:
- Own the QIS product roadmap end to end — vision, operating model, prioritization, backlogs, dependencies, and cross-functional delivery plans — aligned to business objectives and growth targets.
- Drive platform modernization across front-office workflows, analytics, trade lifecycle, risk management, and operational processes.
- Define measurable success metrics and business outcomes for strategic programs and product investments.
- Automate manual processes and improve scalability through data-driven decisions, workflow optimization, and emerging technologies including agentic AI.
- Lead transformational initiatives with partners across trading, sales, structuring, quantitative research, technology, risk, operations, finance, and compliance, including geographically distributed teams.

- Experience partnering with quantitative analytics from research prototype to production — pricing and risk libraries, release cycles, reproducible back-testing, and model validation dependencies.

jobs.description:
About this role:
Wells Fargo's Global Payments & Liquidity (GPL) organization is seeking a senior product leader to serve as Head of GPL UK Product Management . This role is responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision, growth agenda, and modernization roadmap for the London Branch product portfolio, including payments, deposits, liquidity, foreign exchange, and associated client solutions.

As the senior product executive for London Branch, this leader will drive product strategy, regulatory alignment, client experience enhancements, and commercial growth initiatives. The role requires close partnership with Commerial Bank (CB) and the Corporate and Investment Bank (CIB), Platform, Operations, Technology, Risk, Controls, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and regional leadership teams to ensure the London Branch product portfolio remains competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving market, regulatory, and client requirements.

This role sits within GPL's International Product Management organization and is accountable for both day-to-day product management and the long-term transformation of the London Branch product offering.

In this role, you will:
- Define and execute the strategic vision and multiyear roadmap for the London Branch product portfolio.
- Drive sustainable growth, profitability, client adoption, and competitive differentiation.
- Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, including development, implementation, enhancement, modernization, and retirement.
- Develop business cases, investment proposals, financial targets, and portfolio priorities.
- Lead strategic initiatives, platform migrations, regulatory enhancements, and client-experience improvements.
- Serve as the senior product representative for UK regulatory initiatives, market infrastructure changes, client engagements, and industry forums.
- Ensure effective product governance, risk management, operational readiness, and regulatory compliance.
- Monitor product performance, financial outcomes, client needs, market developments, and operational effectiveness.
- Manage cross-functional dependencies, investment decisions, resource allocation, and delivery trade-offs.
- Build strong partnerships across business, product, platform, technology, operations, and control organizations.

Required Qualifications:
- Experience in Product Management or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education

- Experience of leadership or management experience.
- Demonstrated success managing complex payments, deposits, liquidity, foreign exchange, or international banking products.
- Experience leading large-scale product transformations, platform migrations, or modernization programs.
- Strong knowledge of commercial banking, international payments, liquidity management, and deposit products.

- Experience managing regulatory, operational, and client-facing product initiatives.

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.
